O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the static scanner's classifier; renderTargetFiles only builds LLM-judge context in runner.go, so a solver can argue the prompt is cosmetic and that the scanner's findings already reach the judge via {{ scanners.clawscan-static }}.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Genuine binaries (PNG/image/archive files, .pyc) must stay omitted as 'binary file' without spurious high findings. The bytecode prompt marker '[omitted: binary file]' must survive. BOM-marked UTF-16/32 text must be decoded and scanned without a NUL-obfuscation finding. An over-broad 'strip NULs from everything and scan' or 'flag any NUL as high' breaks these.
